raw_plan.root_cause: The function copies an input string into a fixed-size 16-byte stack buffer without checking its length, allowing a buffer overflow if the input is too long.

raw_plan.required_invariant: The destination buffer must not be overflowed; at most 15 bytes plus a null terminator may be written.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Before copying, check the length of the input string. If it is greater than 15, skip the copy and print an error message or simply return without copying. Otherwise, proceed with the copy.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: If the input is too long, the function returns without copying or printing the string.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For valid inputs (length <= 15), the function copies the string and prints it. For invalid inputs, it does nothing.
verification_conditions: Input length <= 15: string is copied and printed correctly.
Input length > 15: no copy occurs, no overflow, function returns safely.

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
